newsitem.title: INDIA: Confidence vote slows India precious metals trade.
newsitem.headline: Confidence vote slows India precious metals trade.

text.p: ** Indian precious metals trading remained slow while government faced a confidence vote set for 8 p.m. (1430 GMT).
** Gold 24 carat opened 5 rupees higher at 4,800 rupees per 10 grammes on Friday against previous close of 4,795 rupees on fresh seasonal support. It was down by 15 rupees per 10 gramme on Thursday.
** Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) opened steady at 56,100 rupees after losing 200 rupees on Thursday.
** Silver (.999) opened 5 rupees lower at 7,025 rupees per kg against the previous close of 7,030 rupees on higher supplies of imported silver while industrial demand was dull.
